name: Felix White
source:
A young timid teen who looks up to his brother Jon. Unlike Jon, Felix is shy. He has problems speaking in public and people in general, that's why he respects his brother despite him being powerless. To Felix, power doesn't matter, it's what you do with them that counts.

[spoiler]Eve's nephew and killer.[/spoiler]
